notes: One closed ledger entry plus the full seven-operation transcript that produced it, one JSON object per line, and the matching ledger.log append lines (ts op dispatch_id actor). The op names are frozen: create-entry, claim, update-status, add-constraint, add-followup, close-out, query. ops.jsonl validates per line, ledger.log per line against the log_line regex. ops.jsonl validates line by line against ledger-entry.schema.json#/$defs/op_call, the record shape that wraps the frozen op enum: op, dispatch_id, actor and at are required and args stays open, because the op name is what selects the argument shape.
